resolved_findings.verification: The observer accepts Repaint only and clears the dictionary for each mode:virtual start, changed frame or changed view reference. Completion is source-pinned to quit without review and import-cancel with review. Publication requires open current host DTO, identical renderer/host/observed references, exact serialized content, current or immediately preceding frame, and unchanged width/height. New/mutated/mismatched/closed DTO, incomplete or expired observations and resize publish an empty binder set. The unchanged renderer was read in full to verify registration order and policy; the external harness independently checks the complete exact name set, current sorted page selectors, selected-detail controls, backup/review controls and enabled flags. Disabled historical selectors are also rejected.
resolved_findings.actual_evidence: All 82 acknowledgements were checked. There are 39 binder-open complete-repaint snapshots and 43 explicitly source-pinned table-layout snapshots, not 82 binder-registration snapshots. All 39 binder selector sets exactly match their current sorted page; pending physical retry, review and pending import contain only their current selectors with required disabled policy. Page1/page0 selectors are disjoint sets of12; search has the actual matching rows. No historical binder selector is present in any of the43 table snapshots.
resolved_findings.no_op_guard: All74 native button-click acknowledgements have passed false-before-action checks. Exact extracted click/ensure helpers were independently exercised with offline dispatch/ack stubs: an already-satisfied click fails before dispatch, ensure skips an already-satisfied setup, and an unsatisfied predicate needs dispatch and an observed changed state. Quantity and search require actual changes; fault arming and Escape have their own meaningful transitions. Quit is separately registered and followed by actual process exit. These offline helper fixtures are not additional graphical actions.

resolved_findings.verification: The standalone audit now derives closure from the loaded compiler list rather than accepting the build summary. It rejects count/duplicate disagreement and changed/missing delivered inputs; extras must be lexical Assets/*.meta descendants without backslashes/dot/dotdot/absolute traversal, must pass reparse checks, must name an actual folder, and must contain a bounded strict-UTF8 folder-meta marker with the exact compiler SHA256. The independently derived closure must equal the claimed summary. main invokes this before candidate acceptance and republishes the derived result.
